description:
Folding Electric Bike - Fat Bike Fun
The DJ Folding Bike is a fat tire folding electric bike that's easy to use and easy to store. It’s portable, uses less space and with 20" puncture resistant fat tires that will take you almost anywhere, this folding ebike is perfect for camping or touring and when storage space is limited. Enjoy a powerful with a 500W 48V motor with 5 levels of pedal assist and thumb throttle for power on demand. The long lasting 48V LG battery can be dismounted and charged anywhere on the go. The charger has a safety design to prevent over-charged.
There is a lot to love about this fat tire folding electric bike from DJ Bikes Canada. It’s durable, affordable and loaded with extras like front and rear fenders, front and rear racks, an integrated front headlight and suspension, all included for one low price – making the DJ Folding Bike the best value for a 500W electric folding fat bike.
